answer: Proof of burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain proportional voting weight. Like a cold tundra freezing unauthorized growth, this mechanism forces an attacker to incur immense capital expenditure to forge a plume of fake identities. As the dawn of decentralized AI arrives, the cost of subverting the network remains tethered to the tangible financial loss incurred by inflating the agent population, rendering mass-identity spam economically unfeasible.
